errata.notes: The signature sizes for the two-level HSS parameters in Table 3 are all 48 bytes larger than they should be.  It looks like they were computed assuming a 64-byte identifier I in the level-1 LMS public key pub[1],  but the identifier was reduced to 16 bytes in draft -07.  The signature sizes for the single-level HSS parameters are all correct because they do not have intermediate LMS public keys.

While "n" is the parameter used in LMOTS, "m" is the parameter used in LMS. In order to be consistent with the other parts of RFC 8554 and with the IANA registry, the LMS parameter set names need to be changed from "_n32_" to "_m32_". For consistency, all other references to the number of bytes in each node should changed from "n32" to "m32".

Hold for document update.

Errata 7994 changes LMS parameter names to _m32_ in Section 3.3 for consistency with IANA registry terminology, which is primarily an editorial fix for accurate reference. - CFRG co-chair
